caption: A player hits a forehand drive, the ball spinning rapidly as it crosses the net.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A player hits a forehand drive, the ball spinning rapidly as it crosses the net. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: A tennis player must be positioned near the baseline on the side of the court where the ball will be struck.
The player must swing the racket to make contact with the ball, initiating a forehand drive motion.
The ball must be struck with sufficient force to propel it over the net and into the opponent's court, maintaining a low trajectory.
The ball must exhibit rapid spin as it travels across the net, altering its path and speed upon crossing.
